answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to participate in network consensus. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces a cost determined by the market value of the underlying assets. This economic barrier ensures that the system does not hit a nadir of integrity when malicious actors attempt a takeover. As the network expands its horizon, every validation voyage reinforces the security threshold, making fraudulent influence exponentially expensive.
